governing_document: KMC Building Rules & West Bengal Municipal (Building) Rules
authority: Municipal Affairs Department, Govt of West Bengal
climate_adaptations: Warm & Humid monsoon ventilation and delta region waterlogging resilience.

rules.description: Finished plinth level must be at least 0.50 m above street level in flood-vulnerable municipal wards.
rules.remediation: Elevate base plinth by minimum 0.50 m.
